translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content.text: Lusakumunu kuidi mutu wowo thaluꞌandi yidi kuidi mutu wulebakana,
Yave weti ku nkula mu thangu yi ziphasi.
Yave wela kunkeba ayi wela tanina luzingu luandi ;
wela kunsakumuna va ntoto
ayi kalendi kunyekula ko mu luzolo
lu bobo beti kunlenda ;
Yave wela kunkindisa va mfulu andi yi kimbevo.
Ngeyo wela kumbelusa va mfulu andi yi kimbevo.
Ndituba : “A Yave, wumboni kiadi.
Wumbelusa bila kuidi ngeyo ndivodidi masumu.”
Bambeni ziama zilembo tubi mambu mu diela dimbimbi
mu diambu diama : “Thangu mbi kela fua
ayi dizina diandi diela lalakana e ?”
yoso thangu mutu kizidi mu kuthala ;
mutu wowo wuntubanga luvunu.
Ntimꞌandi wufulukidi mambu ma mvuezolo ;
buna wuntotukanga ku nganda ayi wunyolukilanga mawu.
Bambeni ziama zioso zilembo niunguta va kimosi mu diambu diama.
Balembo yindula mambimbi mu diambu diama,
balembo tubi :
“Nsongo wumbimbi wumbuididi.
Kalendi buela vumbuka ko va buangu kioki kalambididi.”
Ka diambu ko nkundi ama wu luzolo,
wowo ndibedi silanga diana,
wubedi kabulanga dipha diama, wumbalumukini.
Vayi ngeyo Yave, wumboni kiadi
wuthedimisa.
Muingi ndiba vutudila landi.
Nzebi ti ngeyo wunyangalalanga mu minu ;
mu diambu di mbeni ama kabika kundunga.
Mu bufuana kuama, ngeyo wutsimba ;
wuthedimisa mu zithangu zioso va tuala meso maku.
Nzitusu wuba kuidi Yave, Nzambi yi Iseli,
mu thangu yi kayimani.
